title: Force DNS Addresses On An Active Data Call
description: Re-writes the DNS server addresses handed out by an active data call and re-publishes mp/ind/data/call_state (status stays CONNECTED) so the PA re-applies them. Backs taf_net_SetDNS simulation: that API carries no DNS values of its own -- it reads them from the DCS profile cache, which is only refreshed by a data-call event. Status is deliberately NOT RECONFIGURED: DCS maps that to TAF_DCS_DISCONNECTED and would call ResetIPv4Addresses(), wiping the DNS.
